playstyle: Six fighters all moving at speed 4, the Godsworn Hunt is a mobile, glass-cannon pack: most carry only 2–3 health but strike hard with 2-damage melee weapons, and two hunters add ranged pressure to soften targets. The warband snowballs on kills — slaying an enemy inspires friendly fighters equal to the target's Bounty and can flood them with Guard tokens, turning each successful hunt into a force-multiplier. Victory comes from aggressive sequencing: pick off isolated enemies, convert kills into inspired and armoured fighters, and ride that momentum before the warband's own fragility becomes a liability.
